text:
Sara Kim: Heads up — found a 410 for an image referenced in docs/apex/runbook.md while following the onboarding quickstart. curl returns 410 from CDN. Anyone own the Apex runbook docs?
docs-bot: Automated link-scan: 1769994444 — detected 1 dead asset in docs/apex/runbook.md (approx line 82). See scan: https://internal-scans.redwood.ai/1769994444
Matt O'Neill: I can take this tomorrow. Can you paste the exact URL?
Sara Kim: image URL: https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/apex-diagram-v2.png
Sara Kim: curl output:
```
$ curl -I https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/apex-diagram-v2.png
HTTP/1.1 410 Gone
Date: Tue, 12 Nov 2024 14:03:12 GMT
Content-Type: text/html
Content-Length: 208
```
Jordan Patel: Is that asset intentionally removed (retired) or moved to a different bucket? If moved we can rehost; if retired we need an updated diagram or better alt text.
Lina Zhou: Quick Q — do we prefer rehosting images under docs-site /static/images/ or point to our S3 shortlinks?
Matt O'Neill: For small stuff, rehosting in /static/images/ is fine — fewer redirects and safer for the quickstart. I can upload and update the markdown.
Sara Kim: If you do, can you also add a frontmatter custodian label so we know who's responsible? e.g., custodian: docs-apex
Jordan Patel: +1 to custodian field. Helps scanning.
Matt O'Neill: Plan: 1) download replacement from design (or reuse archived copy) 2) add to docs-site/static/images/apex-diagram-v2.png 3) update docs/apex/runbook.md link and alt text 4) add custodian frontmatter and small changelog line. ETA EOD today.
Sara Kim: Sounds great — tagging design to check the diagram: @design (fyi).
Matt O'Neill: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs-site/pull/3821 — includes sed snippet I used to swap the old URL:
```bash
# replace external CDN link with local static path
sed -i 's|https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/apex-diagram-v2.png|/static/images/apex-diagram-v2.png|g' docs/apex/runbook.md
```
docs-bot: Linked PR #3821 to ticket DOC-1123 (docs link-rot).
Lina Zhou: Quick review left on PR — suggested a tiny alt-text tweak and a 1-line changelog in the commit message. :thumbsup:
Matt O'Neill: Addressed the alt-text tweak, pushed fix, ready for final review.
Sara Kim: LGTM. Thanks Matt — will mark DOC-1123 as resolved once deploy preview looks good.
Matt O'Neill: Deploy preview shows image served and page renders: https://deploy-preview-3821.docs-site.redwood.ai/apex/runbook — all good. Merging now. :shipit:
Jordan Patel: Nice — thanks for the quick turn. :clap:
Sara Kim: Adding note to the runbook: "custodian: docs-apex" so future scans can ping the right team.
Matt O'Neill: Merged and closed PR. Closing thread.
Lina Zhou: Thanks everyone.
Matt O'Neill: +1 :wave:
